messages:
Samir K: Hey team — I joined last week, seeing an orientation event on my calendar for Friday at 10:00 but the invite time zone looks weird on my machine. It shows PT in the event but my calendar app converted it to UTC and now I’m not sure what local time to join. Also the invite doesn’t have a Zoom link or recording location. Anyone else missing the link? :wave: :raised_hand:

Jess Rodriguez: Welcome, Samir! :wave: The main new-hire orientation is Fri 10:00 PT. Quick conversion: 10:00 PT = 17:00 UTC = 18:00 CET / 19:00 CEST (depends on DST). I’ll repost the Zoom link in a sec — looks like the original invite had a placeholder for external attendees so the link got hidden for some people.

Onboarding Bot: Heads-up — orientation recordings and transcripts will be uploaded to /company/onboarding/recordings within 24 hours after the session. Calendar events are issued in Pacific Time by default.

Priya N: FWIW I had the same thing show up as UTC on Google Calendar — if your calendar auto-adjusts time zones it can be confusing. Use time.is or WorldTimeBuddy for quick checks. For an easy mental rule: PT -> add 7 hours to get UTC (PST/PDT differences apply), then add your local offset.

Samir K: Thanks — could someone paste the Zoom link and passcode here? Also where exactly will the recording live (Drive/Confluence)? I need access to transcripts for accessibility.

Jess Rodriguez: Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 (passcode: rwd2026) :lock: Recording + auto-transcript will be uploaded to Drive folder: https://drive.reddemo.company/onboarding/ (I’ll paste the exact folder after the call). If you can’t see the event details, try opening the invite from the 'Redwood Onboarding' calendar vs the shared mailer — sometimes duplicates hide details in clients like Apple Calendar.

Priya N: Also check the event description for an attached .ics — accepting that one instead of the mail invite usually surfaces the link correctly. If you still can’t find it, DM me and I’ll add you to the calendar.

Marta (People Ops): Quick note: we actually have two orientation tracks next week — Core Orientation (everyone) and Platform Deep-dive (product/eng folks). The event name includes [CORE] or [PLATFORM]. If you’re only supposed to attend Core, you can ignore the PLATFORM invite. We’ll mark recordings with folder names so they’re easy to find.

Samir K: Perfect, thanks for the clarifications. One small request — can we get chapters or timestamps on the recording when it’s uploaded? Makes catching up easier across time zones.

Jess Rodriguez: Great idea — I’ll ask the recording team to enable chapter markers and captions. If that’s not possible for this run, we’ll at least add a timestamped agenda in the Drive doc. :thumbsup:

Samir K: Awesome, appreciate it. See you on Fri (I’ll join at 19:00 my time).

Jess Rodriguez: See you! If anyone is still missing the link in the next 30 minutes I’ll resend the invite and add the Zoom link into the thread again.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder set: "Post orientation recording to Drive" scheduled for +24h after event.

Priya N: Ping me if you want a 1:1 to go over tooling/setup in your first week — happy to help.
